metadata.name: Berlin-Tax German/Berlin founder rule pack
metadata.warning: This file contains workflow and validation candidates, not legal or tax advice. Verify all values against cited official sources before real-world use.

prior_calendar_year_total_revenue_limit_.verification_checkpoint: Before using this threshold, verify the current UStG 19 text and confirm that user revenue is Gesamtumsatz, not profit.

current_calendar_year_total_revenue_limi.verification_checkpoint: Before using this threshold, verify the current UStG 19 text and confirm whether current-year monitoring, opt-out history, and special cases were reviewed.

monitoring_warning_ratio.verification_checkpoint: Confirm the warning ratio is project policy only and not an official threshold.

due_day_after_period_end.verification_checkpoint: Before using a date externally, verify the current UStG 18 text, weekends, public holidays, Dauerfristverlaengerung, and Finanzamt correspondence.

monthly_previous_year_tax_threshold_eur.verification_checkpoint: Before selecting a period, verify the current UStG 18 text and the user's Finanzamt correspondence.

new_business_period_policy.verification_checkpoint: Do not assume a new business is monthly by default. Confirm expected VAT and Finanzamt/ELSTER period before generating submission reminders.

calendar_adjustment_policy.verification_checkpoint: Treat generated dates as candidate planning dates until adjusted for weekends, holidays, extensions, exemptions, and user-specific authority messages.

small_invoice_gross_limit_eur.verification_checkpoint: Before applying small-invoice relief, verify UStDV 33 and confirm the invoice is not for a cross-border or reverse-charge-sensitive case.

regular_required_fields.verification_checkpoint: Before issuing, verify UStG 14, UStG 14a if relevant, and the user's actual tax treatment.

small_invoice_required_fields.verification_checkpoint: Before using relaxed small-invoice fields, verify UStDV 33 and check whether any exclusion applies.

kleinunternehmer_required_fields.verification_checkpoint: Before issuing a Kleinunternehmer invoice, verify UStDV 34a, UStG 19 status, and whether the invoice may be sent as a sonstige Rechnung.

e_invoice_review_required_for_domestic_b.verification_checkpoint: Before issuing domestic B2B invoices, verify current e-invoice obligations, transition rules, and any Kleinunternehmer-specific exception or relief.

fee_single_trade_eur.verification_checkpoint: Verify the current Service Berlin fee table before payment or user-facing fee output.

fee_legal_entity_one_representative_eur.verification_checkpoint: Verify the current Service Berlin fee table before payment or user-facing fee output.

fee_each_additional_legal_representative.verification_checkpoint: Verify the current Service Berlin fee table before payment or user-facing fee output.

fee_online_procedure_eur.verification_checkpoint: Verify the current Service Berlin fee table before payment or user-facing fee output.
